llm_response.reason: The site hosts a fake Battlegrounds Mobile India event with promises of free in-game items and rewards, aggressive and unverifiable user testimonials, misuse of brand names/logos, and urges visitors to log in with real gaming credentials. The domain was registered recently and is unrelated to the developer. All content strongly matches scam website characteristics: unusually attractive offers, phishing for data, ambiguous privacy protection, fake endorsements, urgency, and brand impersonation.
